purpose: Qualitative reviewer-facing examples for the currently registered preset detector models. These images are not a held-out benchmark.

2Dcell.notes: Small COCO-format 2D fluorescence qualitative subset used only to show the existing 2Dcell preset behavior.

organoid.notes: Small COCO-format organoid brightfield qualitative subset used only to show the existing organoid preset behavior.

mitosis.notes: Small annotated mitosis image subset retained from the original qualitative detector evaluation folder.

2Dcell_brightfield.notes: Small COCO-format 2D brightfield qualitative subset used only to show the 2Dcell_brightfield preset behavior.

organoid_fluorescence.notes: Small COCO-format organoid fluorescence qualitative subset used only to show the organoid_fluorescence preset behavior.
